```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

# Identify sample columns
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dat), c("Geneid","gene_name","gene_biotype","EntrezID","MGI_ID","Chr","Start","End","Strand","Length"))

# Helper: split a semicolon field and return unique tokens (ignoring blanks/NA)
split_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- x %>% as.character()
  unlist(strsplit(x, ";")) %>% trimws() %>% discard(~ .x == "" | is.na(.x)) %>% unique()
}

# Summarise one gene_name group according to the rules
collapse_group <- function(df_group) {
  # Gather locus evidence
  chrs   <- unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(df_group$Chr, collapse=";"), ";")))
  chrs   <- chrs[chrs != "" & !is.na(chrs)]
  strands <- unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(df_group$Strand, collapse=";"), ";")))
  strands <- strands[strands != "" & !is.na(strands)]

  same_locus <- (length(chrs) == 1) && (length(strands) == 1)

  # Biotype priority
  biotype_rank <- c("protein_coding"=1, "lincRNA"=2, "lncRNA"=3, "antisense"=4, "processed_transcript"=5,
                    "TEC"=6, "pseudogene"=7, "rRNA"=8, "snRNA"=9, "snoRNA"=10, "misc_RNA"=11, "other"=99)
  biotype_ranker <- function(bt) {
    biotype_rank[bt] %||% biotype_rank["other"]
  }

  # Count totals across samples
  totals <- df_group %>% select(all_of(sample_cols)) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  row_totals <- totals %>% mutate(.rowsum = rowSums(across(everything()), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(.rowsum)

  action <- NA_character_

  if (nrow(df_group) == 1) {
    # Nothing to do
    chosen <- df_group
    action <- "single"
  } else if (same_locus) {
    # Collapse: sum counts; choose Length = max(Length); pick representative metadata from the row with max Length
    idx_lenmax <- which.max(df_group$Length %>% as.numeric())
    meta_row <- df_group[idx_lenmax, c("Geneid","gene_name","gene_biotype","EntrezID","MGI_ID","Chr","Start","End","Strand"), drop = FALSE]
    summed <- totals %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
    out <- bind_cols(meta_row,
                     tibble(Length = max(as.numeric(df_group$Length), na.rm = TRUE)),
                     summed)
    chosen <- out
    action <- "collapsed_same_locus_sumCounts_maxLength"
  } else {
    # Distinct loci share the same symbol → choose representative
    # 1) restrict to best biotype
    ranks <- sapply(df_group$gene_biotype, biotype_ranker)
    best_rank <- min(ranks, na.rm = TRUE)
    df_best <- df_group[ranks == best_rank, , drop = FALSE]
    totals_best <- totals[ranks == best_rank, , drop = FALSE]
    totals_best_sum <- rowSums(totals_best, na.rm = TRUE)

    # 2) among ties, pick the row with the largest total counts
    idx <- which.max(totals_best_sum)
    chosen_row <- df_best[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    # Keep its own counts (do NOT sum across distinct loci)
    chosen_counts <- df_group[rownames(chosen_row), sample_cols, drop = FALSE]
    # But depending on how you subset, indices may not align—rebuild from the selected row index:
    chosen_counts <- df_best[idx, sample_cols, drop = FALSE]

    chosen <- bind_cols(
      chosen_row[c("Geneid","gene_name","gene_biotype","EntrezID","MGI_ID","Chr","Start","End","Strand")],
      tibble(Length = as.numeric(chosen_row$Length)),
      chosen_counts
    )

    action <- paste0("distinct_loci_kept_one(biotype_rank=", best_rank, ";max_counts)")
  }

  chosen$.collapse_action <- action
  chosen
}

# Apply per gene_name
dat_split <- split(dat, dat$gene_name %>% replace_na("NA_gene_name"))
agg_list <- lapply(dat_split, collapse_group)
dat_agg <- bind_rows(agg_list)
```

# Also make gene counts matrix where no ENSMUS IDs are in the gene name column
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --- Filter out Ensembl IDs ---

# Get the original number of rows
original_rows <- nrow(dat_agg)

# Filter to keep only rows that *do not* start with "ENSMUS"
# grepl() searches for the pattern "^ENSMUS" (ENSMUS at the start of the string)
# The "!" negates it, keeping only rows where the pattern is NOT found.
dat_agg_only_known_symbols <- dat_agg %>%
  filter(!grepl("^ENSMUS", gene_name))

# --- Check and report counts ---

# Get the new number of rows
new_rows <- nrow(dat_agg_only_known_symbols)

# Calculate the number of rows removed
removed_rows <- original_rows - new_rows

# Print the summary to the console
message(paste("Original rows in dat_agg:", original_rows))
message(paste("Rows removed (starting with 'ENSMUS'):", removed_rows))
message(paste("Rows remaining (gene symbols):", new_rows))
```

# As an extra, create a seperate expression csv file for each cell type ready for tfactivity
```{r}
# This script processes a main counts tibble (dat_agg) to generate
# cell-type-specific counts files for use in downstream workflows.
#
# For each cell type, it:
# 1. Finds the 4 corresponding sample columns (Young_Rep1/2, Old_Rep1/2).
# 2. Creates a data frame with "Geneid" as the first column, plus samples.
# 3. Creates a data frame with "gene_name" as the first column, plus samples.
# 4. Saves both versions in both .tsv and .csv formats.

# Load necessary libraries
# install.packages("tidyverse") # Uncomment if you don't have it
library(tidyverse)
# Or, load packages individually
# library(dplyr)
# library(readr)

# --- 1. Configuration ---

# Set the base output directory
output_dir <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq/DEG_analysis_STAR_aligned_counts_all_cell_types"

# Set the base for output filenames
base_filename <- "Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final_gene_name_dups_cleaned"

# List of cell types to process (based on your column names)
cell_types <- c("HSC", "MPP1", "MPP2", "MPP3", "MPP4", "GMP", "MEP", "CLP")

# --- (Optional) Load main data ---
# Your prompt mentioned `dat_agg` is already in your environment.
# If you need to run this script standalone, uncomment the following lines:
#
# full_data_path <- file.path(output_dir, "Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final_gene_name_dups_cleaned.tsv")
# dat_agg <- read_tsv(full_data_path)
#
# --- End (Optional) Load main data ---


# Check if dat_agg exists
if (!exists("dat_agg")) {
  stop("The object 'dat_agg' was not found. Please load it before running the script.")
}

# Get all column names from the data
all_cols <- colnames(dat_agg)

print(paste("Starting to process", length(cell_types), "cell types..."))

# --- 2. Main Processing Loop ---

for (cell in cell_types) {
  
  # 1. Find the 4 sample columns for this cell type
  # We create a regex pattern that looks for "_<cell_type>_Rep"
  # e.g., "_HSC_Rep", "_MPP1_Rep"
  cell_pattern <- paste0("_", cell, "_Rep")
  
  # Use grep to find all columns matching the pattern
  sample_cols <- grep(cell_pattern, all_cols, value = TRUE)
  
  # 2. Safety Check
  # Verify that we found exactly 4 columns
  if (length(sample_cols) != 4) {
    warning(paste("Expected 4 columns for cell type:", cell, "but found", length(sample_cols)))
    warning(paste("Found columns:", paste(sample_cols, collapse = ", ")))
    warning("Skipping this cell type.")
    next # Skip to the next iteration of the loop
  }
  
  # 3. Create the 'Geneid' version data frame
  # We select the 'Geneid' column and the 4 sample columns
  dat_geneid <- dat_agg %>%
    select(Geneid, all_of(sample_cols))
    
  # 4. Create the 'gene_name' version data frame
  # We select the 'gene_name' column and the 4 sample columns
  dat_genename <- dat_agg %>%
    select(gene_name, all_of(sample_cols))
    
  # 5. Define output filenames
  # We'll create descriptive names, e.g., ..._HSC_Geneid.tsv
  
  # Base name for this cell type, e.g., ..._HSC
  file_base_cell <- paste(base_filename, cell, sep = "_")
  
  # Paths for Geneid files
  path_geneid_tsv <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_base_cell, "_Geneid.tsv"))
  path_geneid_csv <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_base_cell, "_Geneid.csv"))
  
  # Paths for gene_name files
  path_genename_tsv <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_base_cell, "_gene_name.tsv"))
  path_genename_csv <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_base_cell, "_gene_name.csv"))
  
  # 6. Write all 4 files
  
  # Write Geneid versions
  write_tsv(dat_geneid, path_geneid_tsv, col_names = TRUE)
  write_csv(dat_geneid, path_geneid_csv, col_names = TRUE)
  
  # Write gene_name versions
  write_tsv(dat_genename, path_genename_tsv, col_names = TRUE)
  write_csv(dat_genename, path_genename_csv, col_names = TRUE)
  
  print(paste("Successfully processed and saved 4 files for", cell))
  
} # End of for loop

print("All cell types processed.")

```

```{r}
## ===== Identify HSC columns =====
hsc_cols <- grep("HSC", colnames(dat_agg), value = TRUE)
if (length(hsc_cols) == 0) stop("No columns containing 'HSC' were found.")
message("HSC sample columns detected (", length(hsc_cols), "): ",
        paste(hsc_cols, collapse = ", "))
```


```{r}
## ===== Build stable gene labels =====
# Prefer gene_name; fall back to Geneid if missing/blank.
gene_labels <- ifelse(is.na(dat_agg$gene_name) | dat_agg$gene_name == "", dat_agg$Geneid, dat_agg$gene_name)

# Ensure rownames are unique (should be already, but just in case)
if (any(duplicated(gene_labels))) {
  message("Note: gene_name duplicates detected; making rownames unique by appending Geneid.")
  gene_labels <- ifelse(duplicated(gene_labels) | duplicated(gene_labels, fromLast = TRUE),
                        paste0(dat_agg$gene_name, "__", dat_agg$Geneid),
                        gene_labels)
}
```


```{r}
## ===== TPM for HSC samples =====
# Keep rows with valid lengths for TPM
tpm_dat_agg <- dat_agg %>% filter(is.finite(Length), Length > 0)

# Extract HSC count matrix
hsc_counts_mat <- tpm_dat_agg %>%
  select(all_of(hsc_cols)) %>%
  as.matrix()
storage.mode(hsc_counts_mat) <- "numeric"
rownames(hsc_counts_mat) <- gene_labels[match(rownames(hsc_counts_mat), rownames(hsc_counts_mat))] # no-op; keep for clarity
rownames(hsc_counts_mat) <- gene_labels[match(1:nrow(tpm_dat_agg), 1:nrow(tpm_dat_agg))]
```


```{r}
head(hsc_counts_mat)
```



```{r}
# TPM function
counts_to_tpm <- function(counts_vec, lengths_bp) {
  lengths_kb <- lengths_bp / 1000
  rpk <- counts_vec / lengths_kb
  scale_factor <- sum(rpk, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6
  if (!is.finite(scale_factor) || scale_factor == 0) return(rep(0, length(rpk)))
  rpk / scale_factor
}

tpm_mat <- apply(hsc_counts_mat, 2, counts_to_tpm, lengths_bp = tpm_dat_agg$Length)
tpm_df <- as_tibble(tpm_mat, .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
  mutate(gene_name = gene_labels[match(1:nrow(tpm_dat_agg), 1:nrow(tpm_dat_agg))], .before = 1)

# Write TPM table (HSC only), first column = gene_name
tpm_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_TPM_matrix.tsv"))
write_tsv(tpm_df, tpm_out)
message("TPM matrix (HSC only): ", tpm_out)
```

```{r}
head(tpm_df)
```

# OLD VS YOUNG #
```{r}
## ===== DESeq2: Old_HSC vs Young_HSC (raw counts, HSC only) =====
# Subset to HSC columns from the *original* data (even if some Length rows were filtered from TPM)
hsc_counts_full <- dat_agg %>% select(all_of(hsc_cols)) %>% as.matrix()
storage.mode(hsc_counts_full) <- "integer"
rownames(hsc_counts_full) <- gene_labels

# Sample metadata: condition from column names
sample_names <- colnames(hsc_counts_full)
condition <- ifelse(str_detect(sample_names, "_Old_"), "Old", "Young")
coldata <- data.frame(
  sample = sample_names,
  condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Young","Old")),
  row.names = sample_names,
  check.names = FALSE
)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = hsc_counts_full,
                              colData   = coldata,
                              design    = ~ condition)

# Filter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]

dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition","Old","Young"))  # log2FC = Old / Young

# Assemble results with gene_name as first column
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene_name") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj, desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  mutate(direction = case_when(
    is.na(padj) ~ NA_character_,
    padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up_in_Old",
    padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Down_in_Old",
    TRUE ~ "NS"
  ))

res_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_DESeq2_Old_vs_Young_results.tsv"))
write_tsv(res_df, res_out)

# Convenience exports: size-factor normalized counts and VST
norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_name")
norm_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_DESeq2_normalized_counts.tsv"))
write_tsv(norm_counts, norm_out)

vst_mat <- assay(vst(dds, blind = TRUE)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_name")
vst_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_DESeq2_VST.tsv"))
write_tsv(vst_mat, vst_out)

# Also: DE genes up in Old (padj <= 0.05 & log2FC > 0)
up_in_old <- res_df %>% filter(direction == "Up_in_Old")
up_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_DEGs_Up_in_Old_padj05.tsv"))
write_tsv(up_in_old, up_out)

message("Done.")

message("DESeq2 results (Old vs Young, HSC): ", res_out)
message("DESeq2 normalized counts: ", norm_out)
message("DESeq2 VST: ", vst_out)
message("DEGs Up in Old (padj<=0.05): ", up_out)

```

# YOUNG VS OLD #
```{r}
## ===== DESeq2: Young_HSC vs Old_HSC (raw counts, HSC only) =====
# Subset to HSC columns from the *original* data (even if some Length rows were filtered from TPM)
hsc_counts_full <- dat_agg %>% select(all_of(hsc_cols)) %>% as.matrix()
storage.mode(hsc_counts_full) <- "integer"
rownames(hsc_counts_full) <- gene_labels

# Sample metadata: condition from column names
sample_names <- colnames(hsc_counts_full)
condition <- ifelse(str_detect(sample_names, "_Old_"), "Old", "Young")
coldata <- data.frame(
  sample = sample_names,
  condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Young","Old")), # 'Young' remains the reference level, but we explicitly define the contrast below
  row.names = sample_names,
  check.names = FALSE
)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = hsc_counts_full,
                              colData   = coldata,
                              design    = ~ condition)

# Filter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]

dds <- DESeq(dds)

# ***MODIFIED***: Flipped contrast to Young vs Old
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition","Young","Old"))  # log2FC = Young / Old

# Assemble results with gene_name as first column
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene_name") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj, desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  # ***MODIFIED***: Updated direction labels
  mutate(direction = case_when(
    is.na(padj) ~ NA_character_,
    padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up_in_Young",
    padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Down_in_Young",
    TRUE ~ "NS"
  ))

# ***MODIFIED***: Updated output filename
res_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_DESeq2_Young_vs_Old_results.tsv"))
write_tsv(res_df, res_out)

# Convenience exports: size-factor normalized counts and VST
# (These file names are generic and do not need to change)
norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_name")
norm_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_DESeq2_normalized_counts.tsv"))
write_tsv(norm_counts, norm_out)

vst_mat <- assay(vst(dds, blind = TRUE)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_name")
vst_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_DESeq2_VST.tsv"))
write_tsv(vst_mat, vst_out)

# ***MODIFIED***: Changed to filter for DE genes up in Young
# Also: DE genes up in Young (padj <= 0.05 & log2FC > 0)
up_in_young <- res_df %>% filter(direction == "Up_in_Young")
up_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_DEGs_Up_in_Young_padj05.tsv"))
write_tsv(up_in_young, up_out)

# ***MODIFIED***: Updated log messages
message("Done.")

message("DESeq2 results (Young vs Old, HSC): ", res_out)
message("DESeq2 normalized counts: ", norm_out)
message("DESeq2 VST: ", vst_out)
message("DEGs Up in Young (padj<=0.05): ", up_out)
```

```{r}
# R script to check for annotation mismatches between a counts file and a GTF

library(rtracklayer)

GTF_FILE <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Reference_genomes/mm39/ensembl_release-113/Mus_musculus.GRCm39.113.gtf"

# Extract unique gene IDs and names from counts file
# Remove any potential NA values from the lists
counts_gene_ids <- unique(Counts_df$Geneid)
counts_gene_ids <- counts_gene_ids[!is.na(counts_gene_ids)]

counts_gene_names <- unique(Counts_df$gene_name)
counts_gene_names <- counts_gene_names[!is.na(counts_gene_names)]

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d rows.\n", nrow(Counts_df)))
cat(sprintf("Found %d unique, non-NA Geneids in counts file.\n", length(counts_gene_ids)))
cat(sprintf("Found %d unique, non-NA gene_names in counts file.\n\n", length(counts_gene_names)))
```


```{r}
# --- Load GTF File ---
cat(sprintf("Loading GTF file: %s\nThis may take a minute...\n", GTF_FILE))
tryCatch({
    gtf <- rtracklayer::import(GTF_FILE)
}, error = function(e) {
    stop(sprintf("Failed to read GTF file. Is the path correct? Error: %s", e$message))
})

# Extract all unique gene_id and gene_name attributes from the *entire* GTF
# featureCounts and other tools read all attributes, not just from "gene" type lines.
# This is the most robust way to check.
gtf_metadata <- mcols(gtf)

# Get all unique, non-NA gene_ids
gtf_all_gene_ids <- unique(gtf_metadata$gene_id)
gtf_all_gene_ids <- gtf_all_gene_ids[!is.na(gtf_all_gene_ids)]

# Get all unique, non-NA gene_names
gtf_all_gene_names <- unique(gtf_metadata$gene_name)
gtf_all_gene_names <- gtf_all_gene_names[!is.na(gtf_all_gene_names)]

cat("GTF file loaded and parsed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Found %d unique, non-NA gene_id attributes in GTF.\n", length(gtf_all_gene_ids)))
cat(sprintf("Found %d unique, non-NA gene_name attributes in GTF.\n\n", length(gtf_all_gene_names)))

```


```{r}
# --- Compare and Report ---

cat("--- Checking Geneid (Ensembl IDs) ---\n")
missing_ids <- setdiff(counts_gene_ids, gtf_all_gene_ids)

if (length(missing_ids) == 0) {
    cat("SUCCESS: All Geneids from the counts file are present in the GTF file.\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("ERROR: Found %d Geneids in the counts file that are NOT in the GTF file.\n", length(missing_ids)))
    
    # Show a sample of missing IDs
    if (length(missing_ids) > 50) {
        cat("Showing the first 50 missing Geneids:\n")
        print(head(missing_ids, 50))
    } else {
        cat("Missing Geneids:\n")
        print(missing_ids)
    }
}

cat("\n--- Checking gene_name (Gene Symbols) ---\n")
missing_names <- setdiff(counts_gene_names, gtf_all_gene_names)

if (length(missing_names) == 0) {
    cat("SUCCESS: All gene_names from the counts file are present in the GTF file.\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("WARNING: Found %d gene_names in the counts file that are NOT in the GTF file.\n", length(missing_names)))
    
    # Show a sample of missing names
    if (length(missing_names) > 50) {
        cat("Showing the first 50 missing gene_names:\n")
        print(head(missing_names, 50))
    } else {
        cat("Missing gene_names:\n")
        print(missing_names)
    }
}

cat("\n--- Analysis Complete ---\n")

```


# Add a ensembl ID column to the DESeq2 results tsv file
```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))

res_path <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq/DEG_analysis_STAR_aligned_counts_all_cell_types/DESeq2_analysis_of_Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_HSC_only_DESeq2_Old_vs_Young_results.tsv"
map_path <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq/DEG_analysis_STAR_aligned_counts_all_cell_types/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final_gene_name_dups_cleaned.tsv"
out_path <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq/DEG_analysis_STAR_aligned_counts_all_cell_types/DESeq2_analysis_of_Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_HSC_only_DESeq2_Old_vs_Young_results_with_ensembl_ID.tsv"

# Read DESeq2 results (already ordered by padj ascending per your file)
res <- fread(res_path, sep = "\t")

# Read mapping (we only need Geneid <-> gene_name)
map <- fread(map_path, sep = "\t", select = c("Geneid", "gene_name"))

# Sanity checks
if (anyDuplicated(map$gene_name))
  stop("Mapping file contains duplicated gene_name entries; resolve before proceeding.")

n0 <- nrow(res)

# Left-join by gene_name, preserve original order
res2 <- merge(res, map, by = "gene_name", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

# Reorder columns: Geneid, gene_name, then the rest in their original order
first_cols <- c("Geneid", "gene_name")
other_cols <- setdiff(names(res2), first_cols)
setcolorder(res2, c(first_cols, other_cols))

# Validate: same row count and same padj ordering (merge with sort=FALSE preserves order)
if (nrow(res2) != n0)
  stop("Row count changed after merge; aborting write.")
# Optional: ensure no NA in Geneid (comment out if some genes legitimately lack IDs)
# if (any(is.na(res2$Geneid))) stop("Some rows lack Geneid after mapping.")

# Write TSV (no quotes)
fwrite(res2, out_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

```

```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))

# Inputs / outputs
res_path <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq/DEG_analysis_STAR_aligned_counts_all_cell_types/DESeq2_analysis_of_Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_HSC_only_DESeq2_Old_vs_Young_results.tsv"
map_path <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq/DEG_analysis_STAR_aligned_counts_all_cell_types/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final_gene_name_dups_cleaned.tsv"

out_path_normal <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq/DEG_analysis_STAR_aligned_counts_all_cell_types/DESeq2_analysis_of_Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_HSC_only_DESeq2_Old_vs_Young_results_with_ensembl_ID.tsv"
out_path_caps   <- "/vast/projects/Immune_Aging/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq/DEG_analysis_STAR_aligned_counts_all_cell_types/DESeq2_analysis_of_Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_STAR_aligned_counts_final/Itokawa_et_al_2022_RNAseq_HSC_only_DESeq2_Old_vs_Young_results_with_ensembl_ID_ALL_CAPS.tsv"

# Read DESeq2 results and the mapping (only need Geneid <-> gene_name)
res <- fread(res_path, sep = "\t")
map <- fread(map_path, sep = "\t", select = c("Geneid", "gene_name"))

# Sanity: mapping should have unique gene_name
if (anyDuplicated(map$gene_name))
  stop("Mapping file contains duplicated gene_name entries; resolve before proceeding.")

n0 <- nrow(res)

# Left-join by gene_name, keep original order (assumed padj asc)
res2 <- merge(res, map, by = "gene_name", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

# Reorder columns: Geneid, gene_name, then the rest
first_cols <- c("Geneid", "gene_name")
setcolorder(res2, c(first_cols, setdiff(names(res2), first_cols)))

# Validate row count preserved
if (nrow(res2) != n0) stop("Row count changed after merge; aborting.")

# Write the normal-cased version
fwrite(res2, out_path_normal, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

# Create and write the ALL CAPS version of gene_name
res2_caps <- copy(res2)
res2_caps[, gene_name := toupper(gene_name)]
# (Row count and order unchanged, columns unchanged)
fwrite(res2_caps, out_path_caps, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```
